final: WITH media_groups AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS ratio_avg, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS ratio_avg FROM media_groups HAVING AVG(ratio_avg) IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.ratio_avg), AVG(g.track_count), AVG(g.ratio_avg - o.ratio_avg) FROM media_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON g.ratio_avg > o.ratio_avg
